title: MAADBench: The Refreshable Paradigm for Anomaly Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.36556v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies report that LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) fail at rates of 41%-87%, yet to our knowledge, no benchmark to date supports systematic anomaly detection (AD) for them. Building MAS AD benchmarks is hard because they must remain fresh as LLM systems evolve: tasks may leak into training data and thus be memorized by LLMs, traces and anomaly patterns expire as backbones evolve, and labels must be provided reliably for each refresh. To address these challenges, we present MAADBench (MA: multi-agent; AD: anomaly detection), the first refreshable MAS AD benchmark designed for diverse, evolving LLM backbones underlying the agents. MAADBench combines (1) sampled-and-coupled generative tasks over an approximately 10^37-task space to mitigate task leakage, (2) refreshable trace generation under configurable LLM backbones, and (3) automated provision of cost-free, deterministic step-level labels for fine-grained AD evaluation. translated_title: MAADBench：多智能体系统中异常检测的可刷新范式
translated_abstract: 近期研究报道，基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）的失败率高达41%至87%，然而据我们所知，迄今为止尚无基准测试支持对它们进行系统性的异常检测（AD）。构建MAS异常检测基准十分困难，因为随着LLM系统的演进，基准必须保持新鲜：任务可能泄漏到训练数据中从而被LLM记住，轨迹和异常模式会随着骨干模型的演进而过期，且每次刷新都必须可靠地提供标签。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了MAADBench（MA：多智能体；AD：异常检测），这是首个为智能体背后多样化、不断演进的LLM骨干模型设计的可刷新MAS异常检测基准。MAADBench结合了：（1）在约10^37任务空间上的采样与耦合生成式任务，以缓解任务泄漏问题；（2）在可配置LLM骨干模型下的可刷新轨迹生成；（3）自动提供零成本、确定性的步骤级标签，用于细粒度的异常检测评估。
tldr: MAADBench是首个面向LLM多智能体系统的可刷新异常检测基准，通过约10^37规模任务空间的生成式任务、可配置骨干模型的轨迹生成以及自动零成本步骤级标签，解决了任务泄漏、数据过期和标签获取三大难题。
en_tdlr: MAADBench is the first refreshable anomaly detection benchmark for LLM-based multi-agent systems, combining generative tasks over a ~10^37 task space, refreshable trace generation with configurable backbones, and automated cost-free step-level labels to tackle task leakage, data staleness, and labeling challenges.
